name: chquery
title_zh: ClickHouse 查询看不懂就甩给它
tagline_zh: EXPLAIN 输出又长又乱？贴进 chquery，它把执行计划拆成能看的图，顺手抹掉库名表名，链接可直接丢给同事。
tagline_en: Tired of wall-of-text EXPLAIN output? Paste your query, get a clean visual plan with identifiers redacted, ready.
desc_en: Uses chquery.com to explain or visualize a ClickHouse query and return a redacted query plan link. Use when the user mentions chquery, says "explain/visualize this ClickHouse query", or asks for a ClickHouse query plan.
why_zh: 不是本地解析器，而是真调 chquery.com 的渲染服务——所以支持最新语法，脱敏在服务端完成。
why_en: It calls chquery.com's real rendering engine, not a local guesser—so it handles current syntax and redacts identifiers.
limit_zh: 只认 ClickHouse 方言，不认 PostgreSQL/MySQL。需要能访问 chquery.com 的网络。
limit_en: ClickHouse dialect only. Requires network access to chquery.com. Output is a link, not an image—recipient must reach the same domain.
title_en: Paste a ClickHouse query, get a redacted plan link
